source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Ethical Use of Technology (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Technology ke ethical istemal ka matlab hai zimmedari se kaam karna aur digital amal se nuqsan na pohanchana. Is mein privacy, insaf aur maloomat ko sahi tarah sambhalne ka ehtram shamil hai. Ethical guidelines (akhlaqi rehnuma usool) par chalna online bharosa aur hifazat barqarar rakhta hai. Technology ke faislon mein logon, idaron aur muashre par mumkin asraat ka khayal rakhna chahiye. Digital tools ka zimmedarana istemal mehfooz aur munsifana digital mahol banata hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Ijazat ke baghair online content copy karna copyright laws aur digital ethics (akhlaqiyat) dono ki khilaf-warzi ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethical use of technology mein kya shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Zimmedarana amal aur digital kaamon se nuqsan na dena: privacy, insaf aur maloomat ka sahi istemal; faisle karte waqt logon, idaron aur muashre par asar sochna.

items: Ethical use: privacy, fairness, maloomat ka sahi istemal; bharosa aur safety.
